F1_data_source_RESOLVED.verdict: PASS — BLOCKER-3 resolved in Round 3 (Finding 1a absolute-day algorithm correct)
F1_data_source_RESOLVED.summary: The patch correctly changed the data source from PLAN_DATA to GET /api/trip/<id>. However, the useEffect code passes editorTripData.days[activeDay] (array index) to CandidatesSidebar. Codex verified: PLAN_DATA.trips is grouped by city — trips[0]=[day1,day2], trips[1]=[day3,day4], trips[2]=[day5,day6], trips[3]=[day7], trips[4]=[day8,day9]. selDay resets to 0 when selTrip changes. editorTripData.days[] is a flat 9-element array indexed 0..8 = abs days 1..9. For selTrip=2, selDay=0: publishedDay=abs5, editorTripData.days[0]=abs1. Wrong-day candidates are shown.
F1_data_source_RESOLVED.required_fix: Replace editorTripData.days[activeDay] with a day-number match: const publishedDay = PLAN_DATA.trips[selTrip]?.days?.[selDay]; const editorDay = editorTripData?.days?.find(d => Number(d.day) === Number(publishedDay?.day)); Use editorDay everywhere (CandidatesSidebar props, save payload, drop-zone mapping).
